title: The Water Is Wide
source: Traditional ballad ("O Waly, Waly"). Words from Cecil J. Sharp and Charles L. Marson, Folk Songs from Somerset, Third Series (London: Simpkin; Taunton: Barnicott & Pearce, 1906), No. 66 "O Waly, Waly" (Mrs. Cox, High Ham): stanzas 1, 5 ("A ship there is", confirmed in the 1906 print), 4 and 6. Sharp d. 1924, Marson d. 1914.
attribution: The Water Is Wide - Traditional (England/Scotland). Arrangement by Self-Guitar contributors, released under CC0.
